title: Lovász row word
statement: For a Boolean list $S$, form the pair encoding of the empty list with the pair encoding of two words: the chunk of the pair encoding of the one-bit word $[\mathrm{true}]$ and the first component of the second component of $S$, and the chunk of the pair encoding of the first component of $S$ and the second component of the second component of $S$. Apply the width-indexed zip operation with the Lovász entry-word function to this encoded list.
caveat: The encodings, chunk operation, and width-indexed zip operation are not described among the supplied definitions, so their mathematical meanings cannot be made fully self-contained from this payload.
